RemoteConfigCommandEntry.description:
One command of a config transaction: the owner whose namespace it
changes, the command's registered name and its arguments.

description: A config transaction a remote caller submits to one session.

entries.description: The commands, applied in order, all or none.

expected_revision.description: The session config revision the caller wrote the transaction against.

id.description:
The caller's stable id for the transaction; a resubmission with the
same content reuses it, and one with other content is refused.

title: RemoteConfigTransactionRequest
